title: SETTINGS TEXT IN ONE VOICE
why: His note after playing: the UI is not as clean as it should be. In the pictures, the row descriptions in Settings came in two voices: sentence case under THE RAID (his words and the older rows), and long lines in capitals under CONTROLS, DISPLAY, AUDIO, CONTROLLER and ACCESSIBILITY, about forty rows shouting at once. They are all sentence case now. No wording changed, and none of his own lines was touched.
now: Every Settings row description is in sentence case.
